headline: 1 factory address catalogued on Ethereum; full multi-chain deployment list blocked by fetch failures; 2 audits identified, PDF contents unread

findings.text: Etherscan name-tag search returned 'Arrakis: Factory' at 0xea1aff9dbffd1580f6b81a3ad3589e66652db7d9 (Ethereum mainnet) using EIP-1967 Transparent Proxy with implementation at 0xb9bb2856e0af9d3e855b0173a40059fc29b632da. One example vault 'Arrakis Modular: Public WETH/USDC Vault' at 0xf790870ccf6ae66ddc69f68e6d05d446f1a6ad83 surfaced. Block-explorer searches for Base, Arbitrum, BSC/Binance, and Plasma were not completed due to fetch quota exhaustion.

Official deployments doc at https://docs.arrakis.finance/text/arrakisModular/deployments.html was identified via search snippet (contracts deployed on Mainnet, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Ink, Unichain, Sepolia using CREATE3, sharing addresses across networks), but the full page could not be fetched. protocol_metadata.deployed_contracts_doc set to this URL.

Two audit PDFs identified: WatchPug audit at https://github.com/ArrakisFinance/arrakis-modular/blob/main/audit/Arrakis_Modular_Audit_Report_by_WatchPug.pdf and ChainSecurity audit at https://github.com/ArrakisFinance/arrakis-modular/blob/main/audit/ChainSecurity_Spacing_Guild_Arrakis_Modular_audit.pdf. Both PDF fetches failed; in-scope contract addresses could not be extracted.

GitHub org https://github.com/ArrakisFinance confirmed with 22 repositories including arrakis-modular. Direct GitHub repo fetch was blocked by the tool allowlist. Deployment artifacts (broadcast JSON, hardhat-deploy JSON, deployments.json) could not be walked. No pinned commit SHA obtained.

Protocol.chains lists Ethereum, Base, Plasma, Arbitrum, Binance. Docs snippet confirms deployments on Mainnet, Base, Arbitrum and others using CREATE3 (same address across chains). DeFiLlama confirms TVL on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and BSC. Plasma chain: zero addresses surfaced from any source. Per-chain explorer searches for Base (basescan.org), Arbitrum (arbiscan.io), BSC (bscscan.com) were not completed due to fetch quota exhaustion.

Factory at 0xea1aff9dbffd1580f6b81a3ad3589e66652db7d9 identified. Read API call to enumerate vault children could not be completed (defipunkd.com URL not in allowlist at time of fetch). Factory cap notice: this factory may have many child vault instances; D6 enumeration deferred to next run.

Factory address classified as role='factory', actor_class='unknown' (proxy pattern confirmed but no owner/admin read completed). Vault example classified as role='vault', actor_class='unknown'. Docs mention a 2-day timelock on core parameter changes but no timelock address surfaced.

Factory address 0xea1aff9dbffd1580f6b81a3ad3589e66652db7d9 traces to Etherscan search result in evidence. Vault 0xf790870ccf6ae66ddc69f68e6d05d446f1a6ad83 traces to same search result. Implementation address 0xb9bb2856e0af9d3e855b0173a40059fc29b632da traces to Etherscan page snippet. All three recorded in admin_addresses.

rationale.verdict: Insufficient evidence to assign a grade: only 1 factory address confirmed from Etherscan name-tag search; the full deployments doc was blocked, audit PDFs unreadable, GitHub repo fetch blocked, and per-chain explorer searches for Base/Arbitrum/BSC/Plasma not completed due to fetch quota exhaustion. Returning grade=unknown with D-coded unknowns for each gap.

protocol_metadata.about: Arrakis Modular is a non-custodial onchain liquidity management protocol that deploys concentrated liquidity on behalf of token issuers across multiple DEXs (Uniswap V4, Aerodrome, PancakeSwap, Velodrome). Token issuers deposit assets into self-custodial vaults represented by NFTs, and Arrakis's offchain market-making infrastructure continuously rebalances positions, adjusts fees, and manages inventory. The modular framework uses a core Meta Vault standard with per-DEX modules, allowing vaults to operate across or migrate between different DEX venues. Core vault parameter changes are subject to a two-day timelock, giving vault owners time to review or exit before changes take effect.
